The '''Crypt of Tonali''' is one of seven holy sites of the [[Losanium]] religion, located in the [[Tlati Rainforest]]. Built by the [[Old Ones]], the entrance to the crypt is a ziggurat with a large tree atop it, with a passageway in the tree allowing access to the underground caverns as well as the [[Ruins of Mokhaiotl]]. The entrance and the interior is guarded by [[Tonali Warrior]]s and [[Tonali Archer|Archer]]s.

The crypt is the location where the Teok Xiki, or the Gathering, is performed to select a new Teokan upon the death of the previous one. As a holy site, the teoki of Ralos and Ranul - [[Xopanatl, Teoki of Ralos|Xopanatl]] and [[Nenetl, Teoki of Ranul|Nenetl]] - are responsible for the crypt.

==Transportation==
{{Map|1309,3104|1305,3033|caption=Entrances to the crypt|align=left|mtype=pin|width=250|height=250}}
*[[Mokhaiotl waystone]]s can be used to teleport directly inside the [[Ruins of Mokhaiotl]], which is deep beneath the crypt.
*The [[Pendant of Ates]] can be used to teleport to [[Kastori]] just east of the cavern's entrances.
*The [[Quetzal Transport System]] can be used to land at [[Tal Teklan]] or [[Kastori]], both near the cavern's entrances.

==Features==
The [[Tonali Cavern]] is an area beneath the crypt filled with monsters, including [[earthen nagua]], [[grimy lizard]]s, [[skeleton]]s, [[moss giant]]s, [[giant rock crab]]s, and [[rockslug]]s; as well [[moonlight moth]]s that can be caught with the [[Hunter]] skill. Teleporters around the area and a [[Stepping stone (Tonali Cavern)|stepping stone]] and [[Log balance (Tonali Cavern)|log balance]] [[Agility]] [[shortcut]] (both requiring level 46 Agility) can be used to navigate the cavern. A dwarf multicannon cannot be used here as "An ancient magical force won't let you set up a cannon here."

Further north contains a [[Lift Platform (Crypt of Tonali)|lift platform]] that can be activated to allow a two-way transit from the central section of the [[Tlati Rainforest]], allowing quick access to this part of the crypt. West of this lift is a chest which can be looted to obtain two [[Tonali teleporter]]s, which allow instant teleportation between the two nodes placed in this area within a 30 tile range from each other. The western moon chamber contains grimy lizards, while the eastern sun chamber contains earthen nagua, both of which are in a [[multicombat area]] and only appear after completion of [[The Final Dawn]].

Beyond the crypt is the entrance to the [[Ruins of Mokhaiotl]].

==Trivia==
* Tonali is likely derived from the Nahuatl word "tonalli". In Mesoamerican religion, the {{WP|tonalli}} was considered to be part of the soul, located in one's hair. It represents the warmth of the sun, and it is said that losing the tonalli results in illness and eventually death.
